subject: part
title: PART.-----ALT.F.
description: Second diagram on page 437 (MP(I)-11). The crossing diagrams how participation structurally meets alternative-functionalism: PART (participation, again on the subject axis with the arrow — on the right this time) crossed with ALT-F (alternative functionalism — the form's actual alternative-working). PART sits at the right with the subject-arrow, and the main line runs down-left to ALT-F. ACT (activism) branches right from the main line, OMT-DY hangs from ACT, LK-IMP (linkage implications) branches left from OMT-DY, and TRS (transition) hangs from LK-IMP. IST-ACT (isolated activism) branches left from the main line, with POL-CON (political consciousness) rising from IST-ACT. CULT-TF-S (cultural transfer shift(s)) descends from the main line; SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) branches left from CULT-TF-S, (R)INTR (the reality of interpretation) hangs from SOC-RT-DY, and OBS (observation) branches from (R)INTR at the bottom.
